summary: Validated live backend and mobile web onboarding. Backend regression passed; prior and current preview checks reached OTP and permissions successfully. One repeat-phone browser attempt was rate-limited as designed.
action_items: Align the frontend API configuration with the required EXPO_BACKEND_URL contract (current code/env use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL).
Add data-testid/testID attributes to form inputs, primary actions, bottom tabs, and like/pass controls for reliable mobile regression coverage.
Replace LogBox.ignoreAllLogs(true) with targeted ignores so rendering/integration errors are observable.
critical_code_review_comments: src/api.ts reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL while the platform contract specifies EXPO_BACKEND_URL; the current preview works only because the env contains the former.
Most interactive React Native controls lack testID attributes, contrary to the testing/accessibility contract.
The mobile UI displays a fixed 25 km radius instead of the backend-driven config location.defaultRadius.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (welcome -> phone -> OTP -> permissions passed; repeat-phone attempt stopped by expected 429)

seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_ prefixed user/profile through the regression test; no seeded data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo OTP 123456 is intentionally enabled. Razorpay checkout returns 503 configuration pending because plan credentials are absent; this is expected. FCM registration is guarded on web and was not exercised natively.
rca_of_issue: The failed second browser flow reused +919876543210 shortly after the earlier flow. The API correctly enforced the one-minute OTP request throttle (429), leaving the UI on phone entry; use a new test phone for repeat onboarding tests.
